title: The Pool of All Unreached Arrivals

features.name: the mirror of reversals
features.desc-on-touch: you touch the mirror and feel yourself walking away; the reflection shows only the path you didn't take, arriving always a step behind

features.name: the arrival ticker
features.desc-on-touch: names scroll endlessly: Kerrigan arrives 1982, Morrissey arrives 1995, the unremembered arrive never; each entry is displaced by one year

features.name: the unreached gateway
features.desc-on-touch: the arch stands open but the space beyond contains only the attempt to arrive; you can see your own footsteps approaching from inside

features.name: the doubled footprint
features.desc-on-touch: two sets of prints walk this stone: one arrives while one departs; they never meet though they share every step

inscription: arrivals and departures wear the same shoes; every unreached destination leaves a footprint in the pool, and every pool reflects a mirror that walks away

file.name: Arrival_Ledger_Inverted_1950s-2020s.tmp
file.note: timestamps in reverse; each person arrives before they depart; the list grows longer when read backward and shorter when read forward

exits.label: back up into the reversing corridor, where forward and backward are the same colour
toward places where paths finally commit to arriving
deeper into the mirror's own reflection, where seeing arrival means watching yourself depart
